current_sofr.authority: Official NY Fed SOFR is the realized funding-rate authority. SR3 is forward context only.
current_sofr.name: SOFR

funding_view.implication: Hold the full undeployed $100m in cash. Official SOFR 3.85% ACT/360 is about $10,694 per calendar day and is the realized funding authority; deploying stops that yield. Realized overnight SOFR should stay near the new 3.75-4.00 band (just printed 3.85) and therefore print lower than the 3m-12m SR3 strip (4.32/4.58/4.755) which already embeds subsequent hike odds. That overnight-versus-term gap is not a packet-supported SR3 receive: US inflation 72, labor 75, and a delivered Sep-16 hike make receiving poorly timed, while paying the same strip after +15 to +90.5bp overnight is priced. Cash compounds at the official fixing without buying or fading a post-event curve.
